extension.summary: Stop Kodi, run amlogic-multistream, start Kodi again (player not included)
extension.description: RetroArch-style launcher for the amlogic-multistream player on CoreELEC. Launch stops Kodi, runs the player binary (default /storage/amlogic-multistream), and starts Kodi when the player exits. This add-on does not bundle or download the player AppImage/binary; install it at the Player binary path yourself. Use the device AppImage for the box's CoreELEC line: coreelec21-ng-armv7hf (32-bit ARM) on CoreELEC 21 Amlogic-ng, or coreelec22-no-aarch64 (64-bit ARM) on CoreELEC 22 Amlogic-no. The x86_64 and Ubuntu aarch64 CI AppImages are host smoke builds and do not run there.
extension.disclaimer: Kodi is stopped while the player runs. Return to Kodi by stopping the player, for example: systemctl stop amlogic-multistream-launch
